concepts.meaning: Exact source/action/provider identity reconstructed independently of the emitted Operation descriptor.
Whole-node finite cases require a source-derived complete preparation witness and explicit capacity limits; missing coverage is not a passing prefix.
Async-compatible source and native audits retain exact observer, definition, import and workspace evidence; pinned support exceptions never authorize application classes.
Independent source expectation, not generated implementation.
Explicit run-local deferred port; no production-store authority.
Trace and outcomes preserve rejection versus commit uncertainty.
Unimplemented public adapter and finite coverage obligations stay visible, never inferred passing.
The transaction read request and returned Entity identity agree under the declared identity type; reading is not owned invariant validation.
Nested owned write and result values satisfy explicitly selected base factory Rules before commit.
Each generated Event slot uses its captured explicit clock once after value checks; no ambient clock is introduced.
